summary.short: Requires Texas state agencies and local governments to have covered employees and officials complete annual artificial intelligence training alongside cybersecurity training, and directs the Department of Information Resources to certify AI training programs. Effective 1 September 2025.
summary.long: Amends Texas Government Code Chapter 2054 and related provisions. State agencies must identify employees who use a computer for at least 25 percent of their duties, and those employees and elected or appointed officers must complete an annual cybersecurity training program and an annual artificial intelligence training program. Local governments must identify employees and officials with access to a local government computer system and require the same two trainings annually. Local governing bodies must verify and report completion to the department and require periodic audits. The Department of Information Resources must annually certify at least five AI training programs for state and local government employees, update certification standards, ensure AI programs are equal in length to the cybersecurity programs, and publish the certified list annually. Local governments applying for grants under Chapter 772 must certify compliance; a local government determined non-compliant must repay the grant award and is ineligible for another grant until the second anniversary of the ineligibility determination. School district cybersecurity coordinators are covered under Education Code Section 11.175(h-1). The department must adopt implementing rules as soon as practicable after the effective date. The Act takes effect September 1, 2025.
